rows.note: Italy has no statutory minimum wage. Pay floors are set by national collective agreements per sector (for restaurants and bars, the contract for pubblici esercizi, ristorazione collettiva e commerciale e turismo); the agreement's own pay table could not be read from its text, so no floor is given here.
